items.headline: CoreWeave bonds rebound sharply after recent selloff
items.note: 2031 notes recovered to ~82.8 cents and 2030 notes to ~91.3 cents, but both remain well below par, so neocloud funding stress has eased only partly.

items.headline: CoreWeave shares plunge 16% as bond yields near 15%; unsecured notes trade at 76-81 cents
items.note: Unsecured 2031/2032 notes yielding 15-16% and reported record CDS levels signal serious market doubt about neocloud refinancing, with about $4.4B due by end of 2026; Oracle also fell about 9% in the same sell-off.
